title: The Machine of Kepler Reach
author: Ansel Coldharbour
blurb: Coral Yarrow, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
